> A floating knot of white crystal carrying a bubble of dead light. Doesn't hit. Doesn't need to: every gun inside its ring fires slow. Pick one up; hands don't care.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | Regular |
| Threat | High (Support) |
| Base HP | 60 |
| Speed | 1 |
| Damage | 0 |
| Crystal drop | 12 |

## Ability

Chilling Aura: Slows the attack speed of nearby towers.

## How to spot its attack

It never hits you. Look at the ground: guns inside its blue dashed ring fire slower. Kill it, or carry a gun out of the ring.
